before.expected_answer: Take one of two face-up into supply then refill face up from bank; if all taken gain 2 Solari (also without module). Harvest: visit Maker and gain specified total spice that turn including other sources. Immediate upon taking. Acquire The Spice Must Flow on next acquiring that card.

after.expected_answer: With CHOAM, take one of the available face-up contracts on the board into your supply, then replace it face up from the bank if a bank contract remains. The printed icon guide gives 2 Solari if there are none left; this does not require every contract token in the game to have been acquired. In particular, another human with no public contract available gains 2 Solari even if Shaddam's set-aside Sardaukar contracts remain unacquired, and cannot take those reserved contracts. Without CHOAM the icon also gives 2 Solari. Shaddam's own reserved-contract option follows Sardaukar Commander and the FAQ. A Harvest contract completes by sending an Agent to a Maker space and gaining the specified total spice during that turn, including other sources. Immediate completes as soon as taken. Acquire The Spice Must Flow completes when that card is next acquired.

after.expected_answer: Accept Contract uses the Spice Trade Agent icon: draw one card and resolve a contract icon; it does not automatically gain Faction Influence. Dutiful Service uses the Emperor Agent icon: gain one Emperor Influence and resolve a contract icon. Without CHOAM each contract icon gives 2 Solari. With CHOAM, take an available public face-up contract into your supply and refill from the bank if possible; the icon gives 2 Solari if no such contract remains. For another human, Shaddam's unacquired set-aside Sardaukar contracts are unavailable and do not prevent this fallback when the public supply is empty. Shaddam's reserved-contract acquisition option remains governed by his Leader and the FAQ.
